root_cause.text: The `rsi_mac80211_config` function in the rsi wireless driver incorrectly initializes its return status variable to `-EOPNOTSUPP` instead of `0`, causing it to return an unexpected error code during hardware configuration initialization.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows `int status = -EOPNOTSUPP;` being changed to `int status = 0;` in `drivers/net/wireless/rsi/rsi_91x_mac80211.c`, and the commit message states that this default value "triggers a WARN_ON in ieee80211_hw_conf_init".

intent_record.how: This ensures that the function returns success (0) by default instead of an error code (-EOPNOTSUPP) when configuration changes are processed.

bic_trace_step.reason: The function `rsi_mac80211_config` on line 397 initializes its return status variable `status` to `-EOPNOTSUPP` (`int status = -EOPNOTSUPP;`). If the configuration change requested does not include `IEEE80211_CONF_CHANGE_CHANNEL`, the function will return `-EOPNOTSUPP` instead of `0` (success), which causes unexpected errors during hardware configuration initialization.
